motion.name: auth-control-transition
motion.purpose: Auth buttons when prefers-reduced-motion is no-preference.

components.name: Auth primary button
components.description: Primary auth action with inherited semantic colors.
components.css: .ds-auth-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:48px;padding:12px 16px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;background:var(--primary,#e8a317);color:var(--primary-foreground,#1f2933);font:600 14px var(--font-inter,Inter),sans-serif;white-space:normal;cursor:pointer}.ds-auth-primary:hover{background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--primary,#e8a317) 80%,transparent)}.ds-auth-primary:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:var(--ring,#96620a);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab,var(--ring,#96620a) 50%,transparent)}.ds-auth-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-auth-primary:disabled{pointer-events:none;opacity:.5}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-auth-primary{transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out}}

components.name: Auth input
components.description: Readable full-width field with focus and error states.
components.html: <label class="ds-auth-label" for="ds-email">Email</label><input class="ds-auth-input" id="ds-email" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />

components.name: Auth navigation link
components.description: Home, support, and legal navigation with a generous target.

narrative.overview:
This records the completed authentication surfaces only. The existing global Archivo/Inter typography and charcoal/amber identity are inherited. It does not prescribe changes to the dashboard or public marketing surfaces. The auth direction is grounded in `docs/auth-redesign/direction.md`; no new product identity is inferred in the absence of PRODUCT.md.

Generous type and a quiet, unboxed form support contractors entering their workspace between jobs. A charcoal story panel establishes recognition; the theme-aware form ground keeps the task legible.
keyCharacteristics: Spacious controls and compact mobile navigation.
Flat surfaces, fine rules, and amber emphasis.

rules.name: The Amber Ink Rule
rules.body: Primary buttons use dark ink on amber. Small accent text uses the theme's primary-ink role.

dos: Do keep auth sizing scoped to the auth shell.
Do use the inherited semantic theme variables and visible keyboard focus.
Do use the shared shell for account, recovery, invitation, and OAuth error screens.
donts: Don't apply the auth composition or larger controls globally.
Don't introduce decorative raster imagery to this code-led auth direction. The captured screenshots are review evidence, not shipping assets.
